claim: A 2025 Indonesian journal article (Jurnal Ilmiah Edunomika) claiming a quantitative n=60 survey of Indonesian TikTok/YouTube creator income across 5 cities exhibits strong indicators of fabrication: its entire 24-item reference list consists of unrelated STEM papers (photocatalysis, laser optics, orthopedics), two in-text comparison citations central to its discussion do not appear in its own reference list, and its two named case-study creators could not be located on the named platforms under the exact handles given.
stance_target: reliability of Southeast Asian academic-journal survey literature on creator income as a category
scope_conditions: Indonesia, 2025, single low-tier journal article; finding is about evidence-quality/provenance, not about the underlying creator population
quoted_support: Sampel penelitian terdiri dari 60 orang kreator yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling dengan kriteria memiliki minimal 1.000 pengikut dan telah melakukan monetisasi konten selama setidaknya enam bulan. [reference list contains works exclusively on topics such as] 'CuWO4 as a novel Z-scheme partner to construct TiO2 based stable and efficient heterojunction for photocatalytic hydrogen generation' and 'Percutaneous screw fixation of the pubic symphysis versus plate osteosynthesis: A biomechanical study' -- none relate to social media, creators, or digital economy
numbers: 2 in-text citations (Nugroho 2023, Rahmawati 2022) absent from reference list

claim: The unverified/likely-fabricated article's descriptive-statistics table nonetheless illustrates the shape of claim commonly made about Indonesian creators: 65% of a claimed sample had monetized for over 12 months, and 48.3% reported monthly income of 1-5 million IDR versus 30% above 5 million IDR and 21.7% below 1 million IDR -- but these specific figures must not be cited as verified data given the source's provenance problems.
stance_target: income distribution across Indonesian creators (flagged unreliable)
scope_conditions: Indonesia, claimed n=60, unverifiable -- DO NOT USE AS RELIABLE DATA
quoted_support: Pendapatan Bulanan (dalam juta) <1 juta 13 21,7 ... 1–5 juta 29 48,3 ... >5 juta 18 30,0
